Can depend on the instructor. Typically it's well worth it. Additionally NRA instructors have had specific training and certification. Basically like any other skill, you don't know what you don't know until someone teaches you. Shooting is expensive, so if you want to maximize your enjoyment per dollar, then try some lessons. Go with an open mind and be willing to learn.

It may be helpful to talk to him beforehand about what you would like to get out of the lesson. Are you looking for accuracy, better competition skills etc. Let us know what you decide.

You may also want to look into some local shooting organizations in your area. There are many organizations with shooting events to help people make more friends.
